item.title: Singer-songwriter David Archuleta on his new memoir
item.description: Archuleta first rose to fame as a teenager when he came in second place on the seventh season of "American Idol." In his new memoir, he writes about coming to terms with his sexuality and leaving the Mormon church.

item.title: Reflections on the Iran war
item.description: Roben Farzad, who was born in Iran and is in touch with people living there, talks about what he's hearing from them and about the impact the war is having on the Iranian economy.

item.title: Iranian American doctor says regime change, not reform, is what Iran needs now
item.description: Dr. Mahsa Tehrani fled Iran in the 1980s and is now a vocal advocate for regime change there.

item.title: Americans stuck in Qatar in the midst of Middle East war
item.description: Stacey Schuhwerk and her son, Tyler, are trying to return to their home state of Massachusetts but have been stuck in Qatar for days because of the U.S. and Israeli war on Iran.

item.title: Israel strikes Beirut as Iran conflict spreads across the region
item.description: Israel is carrying out its most intense airstrikes in months on Hezbollah strongholds in Beirut, collapsing buildings and displacing thousands as the regional war widens.

item.title: How Massachusetts snowboarder Jackie Hamwey prepped for her Paralympic debut
item.description: Jackie Hamwey spoke from Milan with WBUR All Things Considered host Lisa Mullins about preparing for the Paralympic Games and what her goals are for the competition.

item.title: Maine's catch of lobster declines again as high costs and climate change impact industry
item.description: The haul of lobsters, Maine's best known export and a key piece of the state's identity and culture, has declined every year since 2021. Some scientists have cited as a reason warming oceans that spur migration to Canadian waters.

item.title: Starting your spring clean? Here are tips from Boston's 'Clutter Queen'
item.description: Rhea Becker, who runs a decluttering and organization business based in Boston, shares her advice for starting your spring clean — and how to find the motivation to properly declutter.

item.title: Foxborough town officials deny there's a deal in place over World Cup security costs
item.description: Boston's FIFA World Cup organizing committee offers financial assurances to Foxborough select board for security costs for hosting the soccer tournament this summer, in hopes the board will approve an entertainment license that would allow the games to take place.

item.title: Why 'KPop Demon Hunters' is everywhere
item.description: 'KPop Demon Hunters' is one of the biggest movies on Netflix. It’s also an Oscar nominee that’s spawned chart-topping singles. How K-pop and K-culture became an irresistible global phenomenon.
